The '''Powdermelon''' is a [[Fruits|fruit]] [[Crops|crop]] that grows from [[Powdermelon Seeds]] after 7 days. Powdermelon is one of only five crops that can grow into a [[Crops#Giant Crops|giant crop]]. One Powdermelon can sometimes be purchased for {{Price|2500}} from [[Pierre]]'s booth at the [[Feast of the Winter Star]].

==Stages==
Powdermelon can become a [[Crops#Giant Crops|Giant Crop]].

==Bundles==
Five Powdermelons may be used as one of the options for the {{Bundle|Winter Star||y}}.

==Recipes==
Powdermelon is not used in any recipes.

==Tailoring==
Powdermelon can be used in the spool of the [[2 Willow Lane#Sewing Machine|Sewing Machine]] with [[Cloth]] in the feed to create the dyeable [[File:Farmer Pants.png|24px|link=]] [[Tailoring#Pants|Farmer Pants]]. It can be used as a white [[Dyeing|dye]] when used in the spool of the [[Sewing Machine]] with a dyeable clothing item in the feed.

==Quests==
Powdermelon is not used in any [[quests]].
